latent_model.mask_shape: z_nko: one continuous feature mask per node, propagated hop-token k and original feature channel o; pi_nk shared across its channels. Raw token0 is unmasked.
latent_model.member_index: Uniform latent route index per observed node; variational route-index distribution fixed to its uniform prior. Own mean CE is the corresponding Jensen/variational lower bound, not exact pooled likelihood maximization.
latent_model.model: original native likelihood on attenuated complete graph token bank; W/factors point trained, not full Bayesian weight posterior
latent_model.p_v: independent Beta(alpha,beta) for finite n,k; prior/hyperparameters not yet adopted
latent_model.p_z_given_v: continuous ConcreteBernoulli(pi_nk,tau), fixed tau chosen prospectively
latent_model.q_z_given_v: exactly the same continuous conditional distribution as p; conditional KL zero

legitimate_objective: For the explicit continuous latent-mask model and fixed uniform route-index variational distribution, (1/N_TRAIN) [E_q sum_TRAIN mean_m CE_m plus sum_all-visible-n,k KL(Beta_q||Beta_prior)] is a lower-bound objective. q and p share the same continuous mask conditional. Four distinct private predictors require this route-index interpretation; do not identify their mean log likelihood with log mean probabilities.
member_use: Four member-owned independent latent draws per training update, ordinary own1/M CE, unchanged native softmax probability pool; private BE factors stay learned. This adds stochastic graph-state trajectories, not independent model bodies.
one_operator: For the original K2 full-graph monomial bank, keep raw token0 and attenuate token k1/k2 using a node-conditioned continuous latent mask, before the original shared native Transformer.
